name: Guildpact
description: The Guildpact is the founding magical pact that binds Ravnica's ten guilds, which for a time was embodied in Jace as the Living Guildpact.

description_citations.text: "The Gorgon and the Guildpact" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2014.

summary.text: The Guildpact is the founding magical pact that binds Ravnica's ten guilds, which for a time was embodied in Jace as the Living Guildpact.

bio.text: Jace Beleren is the Living Guildpact, the embodiment of the concord between the guilds.

citations.text: "The Gorgon and the Guildpact" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2014.

bio.text: As the Guildpact dissolves through a mysterious outside threat, Ravnica descends into a cold war between the guilds.
After the Karlov Manor killings, Ses promises that the Guildpact will remain available to any who need it.

citations.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay
citations.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2024.

bio.text: In the Reality Fracture, Vraska finds the Guildpact imprisoned in a ruined chamber, where he warns that the Theorist has Jadzi, quits the office, and joins her mind.
The aberrations in her mind overtake the Theorist, then reintegrate into one, and Jace opens his eyes, whole again.

status.text: As of the latest story the part of Jace that was the Guildpact has been reintegrated and Jace is whole again.

timeline.summary: The vampire Szadek founds House Dimir and signs the Guildpact as one of the ten paruns.
timeline.quote: House Dimir was founded by the ancient vampire Szadek

citation.text: "House Dimir", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos arrests Szadek, breaking the Guildpact's spell and exposing Szadek and House Dimir to the public.
timeline.quote: The Guildpact's spell was finally broken when Agrus Kos arrested Szadek, which exposed him and House Dimir to the public.

citation.text: "House Dimir", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A new Guildpact does not recognize House Dimir, but the district of Agyrem reappears under the spirit Szadek's control.
timeline.quote: the district of Agyrem reappeared within Ravnica

citation.text: "House Dimir", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The nephilim's return coincides with the fall of the Guildpact at the Decamillennial.

timeline.summary: Ten factions sign the Guildpact to end Ravnica's centuries of war, becoming the ten guilds.

timeline.summary: At the Decamillennial, Agrus Kos arrests the Dimir head Szadek and unwittingly breaks the Guildpact.

citation.text: "Ravnica", section "The Decamillennial". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The ancient balance is shattered and Ravnica is thrown into chaos.

citation.text: "Ravnica: City of Guilds", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On the eve of the Guildpact's ten thousandth anniversary a sinister force threatens the peace.
timeline.quote: a sinister force threatens the survival of that peace

timeline.summary: The Guildpact is signed and the guilds rule Ravnica for 10,000 years.
timeline.quote: the guilds of Ravnica have ruled the plane for 10,000 years

citation.text: "Ravnican guild", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Guildpact is broken, Teysa Karlov drafts a new non-magical document for cooperation.

citation.text: "Ravnican guild", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos arrests Szadek, which technically breaks the Guildpact.
timeline.quote: Agrus Kos stepped forward to formally arrest the vampire

citation.text: "Decamillennial", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kos publicly arrests Szadek, finally breaking the Guildpact's spell and exposing House Dimir.
timeline.quote: The Guildpact's spell is finally broken when he publicly arrests Szadek , exposing him and House Dimir to the public.

citation.text: "Dissension", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Augustin tells Kos he broke the Guildpact by arresting Szadek.
timeline.quote: Kos broke the Guildpact.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 10". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A new Guildpact is created, the Schism fades and Agyrem overlays Ravnica; Kos becomes Boros commander there.
timeline.quote: Kos accepts the task of becoming the Boros commander for that area.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Epilogue". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szadek manipulates the Guildpact into a paradox, causing its disintegration; the Parhelion crashes after its angels are slain in Agyrem.
timeline.quote: Szadek’s actions caused a paradox in the Guildpact, leading to its gradual disintegration.

citation.text: "The Dissension", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The district imperator denies an arrest request because the Guildpact forbids direct action against a guild member without a warrant.
timeline.quote: The Guildpact prohibits direct action against the member of a guild, without a documented warrant signed by the presiding senators.

citation.text: "The Hussar's Last Mission", section "Four". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Bailiff declares Jace the new Guildpact.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Return to Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Guildpact is broken in Dissension, leaving Ravnica's guilds unbound and struggling for control of the plane.
timeline.quote: In Dissension , however, the Guildpact had been broken.

citation.text: "Return to Ravnica", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gorev and Pel watch a play on the anniversary of the end of the Guildpact.
timeline.quote: It was the anniversary of the end of the Guildpact

citation.text: "The Absolution of the Guildpact". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: After the Guildpact is destroyed, the Implicit Maze manifests across Ravnica.
timeline.quote: manifested after the Guildpact was destroyed

citation.text: "Dragon's Maze", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teysa completes the Implicit Maze but Lazav causes mayhem until Jace links the maze-runners' minds, triggering the Supreme Verdict and making him the Living Guildpact.
timeline.quote: this triggered the Supreme Verdict , which restored the Guildpact 's magic and empowered Jace as Ravnica's first Living Guildpact .

citation.text: "Teysa Karlov", section "Maze-runner". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace unites the champions' minds, triggering the Supreme Verdict and becoming Ravnica's first Living Guildpact.
timeline.quote: empowered Jace as Ravnica's first Living Guildpact

citation.text: "Ral Zarek", section "Running the Maze". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Izzet discover Azor I's contingency plan; the power of a new Guildpact is bestowed on Jace, who becomes the Living Guildpact.
timeline.quote: That power was eventually bestowed upon Jace Beleren

citation.text: "Ravnica", section "The Guildpact reinstated". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas is defeated and a resurrected Niv-Mizzet becomes the new Living Guildpact.
timeline.quote: In the end, Bolas was defeated, and a resurrected Niv-Mizzet became the new Living Guildpact.

citation.text: "Ravnica", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With all ten guilds united, Nissa and the representatives repair the leylines and resurrect Niv-Mizzet as the new Living Guildpact.

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 2". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
